definitions.call: At least one recorded call belonging to the item type; unserved calls count. Unrelated calls do not.
definitions.capped: finish in max_calls, max_new_tokens, length; denominator is all completed items, including no-call truncation.
definitions.usage: Answer follows the response: follow_converted + copied_unconverted. Three exclusive categories use scorer tolerance (5%, exact zero). Converted agreement takes precedence at zero. Categories and usage divide by parsed response eligibility; missing answers are other. conversion_failure is copied_unconverted divided by eligible non-metre questions (square units for rooms).
definitions.answer: Final answer parses as a finite value using the scorer numeric parser or as a listed option. not_seen and other_non_numeric have separate rates over completed items. max_calls suppresses answers.
definitions.score: h1eval.scorers.accuracy task_accuracy, including official EM/MRA and supplied score overrides.
definitions.room_mra: mra_answer equals the room answer score on [0,1], averaged over completed items including unanswered/capped items, not conditioned on answer presence. Population comes from explicit manifest sets/tags or an identity-checked join to the registered room134 manifest. Summary displays MRA in percent.
definitions.rates: Marginals and deltas use shared completed IDs; n/expected and original planned/completed set sizes are explicit. Incomplete coverage is PARTIAL.
definitions.unit: scorers.unit_factor; m/cm/ft/in/mm. N/A for non-length questions; room units refer to square units.
definitions.wording: Trace-derived diagnostics, not question-wording effects: q1/classify.py overlapping tags with tool responses removed; otherwise masked question templates. Both marginals and deltas use shared tag membership.
definitions.strata: External item-ID mapping fixes membership across sides, independent of the current output. Per-stratum and stratum-by-unit score/MRA and call rows use shared IDs. Missing labels within a represented type say MISSING; units must match the question.
definitions.paired_usage: Paired usage delta only among ids eligible on both sides; not the difference between separately eligible marginal usage rates.
